name: dansolombrino-skills
description: Personal skills: an always-on core (intent gating, reference integration, project categories, a cross-project work list) and opt-in domain plugins such as research (reproducible GPU experiments across verified rigs).

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Always-on working discipline for every project: mirror intent and hold brainstorm phases until an explicit greenlight, integrate reference code only through approved deviations, tag each project with its categories so domain plugins such as research load only where they belong, and keep one cross-project list of work (ReSirch Killalot) that agents propose into and only the owner accepts.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Materialize reproducible experiments across verified GPU rigs: scaffold projects, provision exact environments, deploy tested revisions, dispatch GPU waves as a self-balancing pull queue, supervise them from the hub without an open chat, keep a fleet-wide GPU lane board, and visualize results.
